subject: ZenLytics MAP kickoff — technical owners & timeline
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Hassan <aisha.hassan@zenlytics.com>, Marcus Boyd <marcus.boyd@zenlytics.com>
Cc: Hiro Tanaka <hiro.tanaka@redwood.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: ZenLytics MAP kickoff — technical owners & timeline

Hi Aisha / Marcus,

Great to meet you both last week — excited to kick off the evaluation with ZenLytics. Per our conversation, I wanted to align stakeholders and propose a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) so we have clear owners and a realistic close target.

High-level proposal (attached MAP spreadsheet):
- Objective: Evaluate Redwood Inference for the 6-week pilot focused on query performance and cost per inference
- Primary evaluation deliverables: 1) end-to-end README + sample workflow, 2) 1-week performance run on representative data, 3) integration checklist for production rollout
- Target commercial close: 2026-11-23 (we can adjust if procurement needs more time)

Who we’ve looped in:
- Soojin Lee (me) — Account lead / MAP owner
- Hiro Tanaka — Solutions Engineer (technical evaluation lead)
- Dylan Brooks — Solutions Ops (test infra & ingest)
- Rachel Kim — Sales Manager (escalation & timelines)

A few asks for the MAP kickoff call:
1) Can Marcus confirm the engineering lead who will be primary for hands-on testing?
2) Please share any compliance/security blockers we should pre-check (SOC2 / encryption requirements)
3) Confirm two 60-minute slots next week for a technical deep-dive + environment access session (we suggest Tue 10/13 10am PT or Wed 10/14 2pm PT)

Attachments: zenlytics_map_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), SOW_draft_zenlytics.pdf (commercial draft)

If this looks good I’ll schedule a 60-min kick-off and Hiro will outline the evaluation plan live.

Thanks — looking forward to working together.

—
Soojin Lee
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

> Great to meet you both last week — excited to kick off the evaluation with ZenLytics.
> 
> High-level proposal (attached MAP spreadsheet): ...

Thanks Soojin — appreciate the clear plan. Marcus here (engineering lead for the evaluation). A few quick notes:

- 10/13 10am PT works best for us for the technical session. If we need a later slot, 10/14 2pm PT is OK but prefer 10/13.
- For the performance run, we’ll provide a 10k sample dataset and a sandbox Postgres instance (read-only) — can you confirm any network/IP allowlisting requirements?
- Security: we will need to see your SOC 2 report and a security questionnaire filled out. Procurement will start the paperwork after the technical sign-off.

I’m copying Aisha (PM) and our security contact separately if needed. Looking forward to Hiro’s plan.

Marcus

From: Hiro Tanaka <hiro.tanaka@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ZenLytics MAP kickoff — technical owners & timeline

On Tue, Oct 13, 2026 at 10:22 AM Marcus Boyd <marcus.boyd@zenlytics.com> wrote:
> Thanks Soojin — appreciate the clear plan. Marcus here (engineering lead for the evaluation). ...

Thanks Marcus — glad you can make 10/13. Quick technical rundown from my side so everyone is aligned before the call:

Proposed 60-min agenda (10/13 10:00am PT):
- 0–10m introductions & success criteria (So We know what “good” looks like)
- 10–25m architecture & data flow (how we’ll connect your sample dataset)
- 25–40m verification test plan (latency/throughput scenarios we’ll run)
- 40–55m access checklist & dependencies (allowlist, test tokens, sample queries)
- 55–60m next steps & timelines (MAP update)

Pre-reqs we need from ZenLytics before the session:
- Sample dataset (10k rows) — S3 or secure transfer link
- IPs to permit for our test harness (I’ll send a minimal list once we confirm environment)
- A short list of 3 representative queries/scenarios you care about (latency vs. quality tradeoffs)

Immediate owners for action items:
- Hiro — technical plan + test harness (internal)
- Dylan — infra setup & staging environment (internal)
- Marcus — provide dataset + allowlist (customer)
- Soojin — MAP owner / timeline liaison

I’ll bring a simple Perf run script and a sample k6 test that exercises streaming generation and batch embedding calls.

—
Hiro Tanaka
Solutions Engineer (ML Infra)
Redwood Inference
hiro.tanaka@redwood.com

Perfect — 10/13 10:00am PT is on the calendar (invite sent). Quick recap of agreed next steps and owners: 

1) Marcus: Share sample dataset + allowlist by 10/12 EOD (Marcus / ZenLytics)
2) Hiro: Deliver test plan and perf script before the session (10/13 9:00am PT)
3) Dylan: Provision staging endpoint and short onboarding doc (10/13 12:00pm PT)
4) Soojin: Update MAP spreadsheet to capture these dates and post meeting notes to the shared Drive (link below)

If procurement wants to start review early, Rachel can assist — Rachel, I’ll introduce you in a follow-up note to help with SOW redlines.

Link to MAP + meeting notes: https://drive.redwood.com/teams/sales/zenlytics/map-v1

See you on Thursday — thanks everyone.
